record.field: # Check if there are any sick days in this payslip result = any(line.code == 'SICK' for line in payslip.worked_days_line_ids)

# payslip object is available in this context # calculate_sick_leave_allowance is our custom method returning the amount to pay total_allowance = payslip.calculate_sick_leave_allowance()
# Odoo typically pays the full basic salary and then DEDUCTS for unpaid/partially paid leave. # So we calculate the deduction amount. # Total days sick = sum(line.number_of_days for line in payslip.worked_days_line_ids if line.code == 'SICK') current_sick_lines = payslip.worked_days_line_ids.filtered(lambda l: l.code == 'SICK') current_sick_days = sum(line.number_of_days for line in current_sick_lines)
daily_wage = contract.wage / 30.0 # The amount that WOULD have been paid if 100% full_sick_pay = current_sick_days * daily_wage
# The deduction is the difference between full pay and the allowed pay (based on tiers) deduction = full_sick_pay - total_allowance
# Return as a negative number for deduction result = -deduction
# Trigger this rule ONLY if there's a specific Other Input code for Termination result = any(input_line.code == 'TERMINATION' for input_line in payslip.input_line_ids)
